observations.title: Radium role and integration boundary
observations.player_action: Use the consuming mod's interface or feature; this component's own installation is not a survival objective.
observations.outcome: Ports Lithium-derived general game-performance optimizations to Forge. JEM disables mixin.world.chunk_access because the exact installed artifact can synchronously wait for an in-flight chunk on the logical server.
conditions: Exact installed artifact metadata, default mixin rules and chunk-access bytecode were inspected.
No runtime behavior or benchmark was verified. Keep the managed lithium.properties guard until player acceptance and a separate causal review approve a change.
observations.review_note: Installed static role is corroborated by the artifact/resource/SHA256 attached to the source. The inspected 0.15.0 artifact still replaces ServerChunkCache.getChunk with a blocking future wait when mixin.world.chunk_access is enabled.
